title: W006 Excel MSForms text-service clipboard paste and transfer oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest and VBA source consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation, public MSForms event handlers, public Windows clipboard, and SendKeys input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, private implementation details, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.
A focused desktop session where Ctrl+V can be delivered to the UserForm.

form.name: OxFormsW006TransferForm
form.caption: OxForms W006 Text Service Transfer Oracle

clipboardSeed.provenance: Literal repo-owned value set by tools/office-oracle/Capture-W006TextServiceTransfer.ps1 before sending Ctrl+V.

manualInteractionScript: Show the fixture modeless, focus OracleTextBox, set the public Windows clipboard to the repo-owned text seed, and send Ctrl+V.
If the desktop session blocks public keyboard input, record the exact blocker and use the public MSForms TextBox.Paste method as a narrower paste/DataObject scenario.
Export W006TransferEventLog as CSV and JSON.
Classify IME/composition, dead keys, and true OLE drag/drop as blocked unless the live run emits rows for those surfaces.

notes.scope: This fixture builds repo-owned Excel/MSForms oracle inputs only. It does not implement OxForms behavior and does not settle final MSForms event ordering by itself.
notes.events: Event handler names and argument names follow docs/specs/FM20_EVENT_FACTS.md. Live output from oxforms-0a0.13 is the oracle evidence.
notes.dataObjectPolicy: DataObject logging uses public MSForms DataObject methods only. The known repo-owned clipboard seed text may be recorded; unexpected payload text is not recorded.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files, screenshots, logs, exported worksheets, and hashes belong under docs/evidence/W006_control_implementation_rollout/captures/ when captured.
